notes: with_skill is the revised skill; old_skill is the previous skill, not an execution without instructions.
Only three synthetic cases, one run per version. These results are not general performance guarantees; between-case variation is not repeated-run model variance.
Defect detection and behavioral false-positive results did not distinguish the two versions here. The observed improvements concern default scope and unsolicited verdicts.

One revised mixed-case maintainability observation inferred shared policy from equal literal values; graded conservatively as insufficient evidence. The explicit shared-policy case was grounded in both versions.
Timing and token telemetry were not supplied by completion notifications; omitted rather than reported as zero.

Investigation records are executor-authored summaries, not complete raw tool transcripts. Output claims were checked against fixture contents; execution-history claims retain that evidence limitation.
